note: THE PLAN THE SHIPPED RECORDER REFUSED, kept as the record of the refusal (cinatra#2930, PR #3014).
This is the branch's own walk format for scripts/audit/lib/chat-hitl-capture-driver.mjs --walk.
It was driven at the parked run and REFUSED, in the two places the vocabulary is closed:
cell "...": kind "agent_hitl_screen" is not one of artifact_review_gate/recommendation_hold/
trigger_schedule_proposal/verification_summary
cell "...": state "asking" is not one of pending/decided
and, with kind and state omitted from the cells:
record "...": a chat_thread record must declare the lifecycle `declaredKind` it photographed
(one of artifact_review_gate/recommendation_hold/trigger_schedule_proposal/verification_summary)
-- it declares "undefined"
scripts/ci/lib/capture-record-contract.mjs:161 CARD_KINDS carries four kinds and no
`agent_hitl_screen`; chat-hitl-capture-recorder.mjs:232 derives LIFECYCLE_KINDS from it, :247 fixes
CAPTURE_STATES to pending/decided, :1063 makes a declared kind mandatory for a chat_thread record
and :1470-:1474 refuse a plan naming either outside those lists. This slice draws a fifth kind and
